rendered: The Table's row for Section 6 – Low-Co/Ni-Rich Cathodes (i.e.[1] names the cathode NMC 811[2], a low-Co/Ni-rich cathode. In the ORNL study the paper describes, the NMC 811 cathodes[3] kept maintaining 80% capacity at 6C charging rate[4]. The corresponding NMC 532 and NMC 622 cathodes[5] only retained 49% and 56% capacity, respectively, at 6C rate[6]. So the cathode named in that Section row kept far more of its capacity at the fast charging rate than either comparison cathode.
